Messages.Author: tigernat1
Messages.Body:
If Ur Shulgi is at long range and strikes with superior Eruption of
Vitae (burning 1 blood and randomly discarding 1 card), does the
additional damage become RANGED because it inherits all of the
properties of the base damage?

Would the additional damage normally inherit the aggravated trait as
well except for the fact that card text specifies it is non-
aggravated?

Eruption of Vitae
[qui] Strike: 2R damage, aggravated. Not usable first round. Only
usable at long range.
[QUI] As above, and this vampire can burn X blood and randomly discard
X cards from your hand to inflict X additional non-aggravated damage
this strike.

Vegas gNat
